title: ECS Metadata

fields.name: add
fields.description: This parameter is similar to the ADD option in the [modify filter](https://docs.fluentbit.io/manual/pipeline/filters/modify).

fields.name: ecs_tag_prefix
fields.description: This parameter is similar to the Kube_Tag_Prefix option in the [Kubernetes filter](https://docs.fluentbit.io/manual/pipeline/filters/kubernetes) and performs the same function.

fields.name: cluster_metadata_only
fields.description: When enabled, the plugin will only attempt to attach cluster metadata values.

fields.name: ecs_meta_cache_ttl
fields.description: The filter builds a hash table in memory mapping each unique container short ID to its metadata.

fields.name: match
fields.description: Tag match pattern used to route records to this plugin. Supports '*' wildcard matching.

fields.name: match_regex
fields.description: Regular expression tag match used to route records to this plugin. Takes precedence over match when both are set.

description: The ECS Filter Enriches logs with AWS Elastic Container Service Metadata.
